surface_functionalization: functional groups formed by acid treatment
evidence: A 3.5- mm-thick layer of acid-treated carbon nanotubes (CNTs) was placed on a Si substrate, and Pt was then deposited on the CNTs by ALD. ... It was observed that Pt could not be deposited on carbon cloth without acid treatment, as shown in Figure 2a. After acid treatment, Pt particles could then be deposited as white dots, as shown in Figure 2b.
